data_preprocessing.Planetoid_reference: Saved2.2 edge_index_from_dict removes loops and coalesces ordered duplicates, without explicit symmetrization. This is not proof of installed2.7 preprocessing equivalence.
data_preprocessing.exporter: Fresh official raw Planetoid cache + NormalizeFeatures; factual feature/edge fingerprints match prior custody; edge_shape[2,88648]
data_preprocessing.feature_reference: Saved PyG2.2.0 NormalizeFeatures subtracts one tensor-wide minimum then divides by max(row sum,1). Actual2.7 formula bytes not pinned in this trace.
data_preprocessing.not_inferred: Even edge count88648 and standard PubMed naming do not prove simple reciprocal support. Raw data unopened.

design_consequence: Native raw PX can be algebraically reused once the exact operator is declared. Future separately justified backbone control would need support/direction metadata audit. No further audit requested for this rejected candidate.

native_cache.implementation: gcn_norm(edge_index,None,num_nodes=X.size(0),dtype=X.dtype) -> SciPy COO -> native float32 sparse tensor -> repeated torch.spmm
native_cache.model_boundary: Stack raw tokens -> lin1(500,256) -> two PolyFormerBlocks. LayerNorm/token MLP/ReLU/tanh/FFN/dropout are inside learned forward.

provider_reference.duplicate_rule: Dense edge-index gcn_norm has no non-self coalescing. SciPy COO and native .tocoo().astype(float32) have no explicit sum_duplicates/coalesce. Loader handling matters.
provider_reference.orientation: SciPy matrix row=edge_index[0], column=edge_index[1]; SpMM accumulates weight*x[col] into output[row], no transpose. Default degrees use col. Reciprocal unweighted support would give symmetric D^-1/2(A+I)D^-1/2; actual reciprocity not verified.
provider_reference.self_loop_rule: Saved add_remaining_self_loops removes self-edge rows, appends one loop per node, preserves existing attributes when supplied. Native edge_attr=None gives appended loops unit weights.
provider_reference.tensor_edge_branch: add_remaining_self_loops -> unit weights -> degree scatter over col -> d^-1/2[row]*weight*d^-1/2[col]

source_chain: Fullfit reuses existing stage1 source context
native_preprocess extracts mono_base and sparse converter from bound PolyFormer utils
